goal: Prepare the next Master Data write-gate boundary without opening Business Central or creating data.
whyNow: Gen. Business Posting Groups are classified as accepted-context but not setup-ready. Master Data work can only continue if the next gate explicitly names which fields are training-only, blocked, source-needed or ready for a future separate write case.
businessPurpose: Keep realistic customer-project Master Data moving while preventing setup gaps from becoming hidden write permission.
expectedOutput: A compact local result JSON classifying Customer, Vendor and Item/Service write-gate fields as blocked, training-only, source-needed or ready-for-future-gate.
A nextCase selection that does not create or edit Business Central data.
Explicit boundary that no setup, master data, document, Preview Posting or Posting change was made.
stopConditions: Stop if the decision would claim Master Data readiness.
Stop if any proposed next case would create or edit data directly.
Stop if Foundation dependencies are hidden instead of shown as gate conditions.
Stop if the case requires Business Central or Playwright live execution.

nextCaseOptions.when: Use only if the prep result proves a narrow customer-field write gate is safer than broad Master Data load and all blocked setup fields remain unchanged.
Use if customer/vendor/item fields should first become an Excel-assisted or configuration-package data map.
Use if Master Data remains blocked by unresolved posting/VAT setup source gaps.
